channel.title: The Awesome Ledger — free-for-dev
channel.description: New entries across the GitHub awesome ecosystem, diffed nightly.

item.title: URLpipe — via free-for-dev
item.description: Read any page after its JavaScript runs: Markdown, screenshots, metadata, console errors and Lighthouse audits. Free 1000 credits per month.

item.title: Stats4U — via free-for-dev
item.description: A visitor counter and web stats service operated from Poland, since 2006. Website owners choose a counter design copy the code and paste it into their site; no account is required. Free without paid plans. Privacy First: Stats4U does not set cookies and Counter data is processed on the operator's own server in the EU.

item.title: Lucid Forms — via free-for-dev
item.description: Form endpoint for websites. Add working contact forms to any HTML, JS framework, or no-code site without building a backend. Free plan includes 250 submissions/month, email notifications, smart spam filtering, and Google Sheets integration.

item.title: flaky — via free-for-dev
item.description: A mock API where you can paste your JSON and simulate API problems like delays, errors, failed requests, and malformed responses. 1,000 requests per day without a key, or 10,000 requests per day with a free key. There is no paid tier.

item.title: Ironfang Render — via free-for-dev
item.description: UK-based screenshot, PDF, image, QR code and clip rendering API with reusable templates and signed URLs. 250 free renders a month with no payment details needed to get started.

item.title: watchcron.com — via free-for-dev
item.description: Cron job monitoring with heartbeat pings and alerts. Free tier with up to 5 monitors and email notifications.

item.title: Formfeed — via free-for-dev
item.description: API for PDF and image generation from JSON with a simple API or automation tools like Zapier & Make. The free plan includes 100 free PDF conversions per month.

item.title: SendRaven — via free-for-dev
item.description: SendRaven provides an email API for transactional email and agent-driven conversations, including inbound replies and threads. The free tier includes 3,000 outbound emails per month, unlimited contacts and inbound replies, card is required.

item.title: Email Spam Tester — via free-for-dev
item.description: Tests the technical part, content, link authority and overall score of your email. Also tests where your email will land: inbox, spam or promotions. Inbox tests on Gmail, GMX, Yahoo, AOL and other email providers. Free to use, no card or registration required. Also works via API and MCP.

item.title: prquorum.com — via free-for-dev
item.description: ai code review github app, free 50 reviews/month on 2 repos

item.title: DevDome — via free-for-dev
item.description: Cookieless web analytics for WordPress that counts human visitors separately from bots and AI crawlers. Free plan: unlimited sites, 50,000 human pageviews per month, 90 days of data retention.

item.title: Estuary — via free-for-dev
item.description: Real-time data integration platform for CDC, streaming, and batch data integration with 200+ managed connectors. Free plan includes 10 GB/month of data movement and up to 2 connector instances, with no time limit and no credit card required.

item.title: DevOpsLesson — via free-for-dev
item.description: Free DevOps tutorials, cheatsheets, troubleshooting guides, roadmaps, interview preparation and DevOps tools: Dockerfile Linter, K8S YAML file generator, Regex Tester.

item.title: Deplexo — via free-for-dev
item.description: Developer-focused PaaS for deploying and hosting applications with Git-based deployments, custom domains, automatic HTTPS, and Dockerfile support. Run Node.js, Python, Go, Java, Rust, PHP, static sites, and more. The free tier includes 1 app with 0.25 vCPU, 128 MB RAM, 250 MB disk, and 100 GB bandwidth.

item.title: myspec.dev — via free-for-dev
item.description: Spec-Driven Development (SDD) architect tool that interviews developers and generates structured 4-file spec bundles with MCP server integration. Free tier covers 20 projects and 100 spec files.

item.title: Tinyfish — via free-for-dev
item.description: Free web search and fetch API with rate limits.

item.title: SnapEnv — via free-for-dev
item.description: Secure environment variable manager for dev teams. AES-256-GCM encryption at rest, CLI, Kubernetes operator, and audit log. Free plan includes 3 projects, 3 members, and 3 environments per project, forever.

item.title: Webhooker — via free-for-dev
item.description: Webhook gateway hosted in Germany. Signature verification, retries, dead letter queue and replay. Free plan: 10,000 events per month.

item.title: OpenWebhook — via free-for-dev
item.description: Temporary webhook URL and live inspector. No signup. Event history stays in the browser. Custom slugs and remote forwarding are paid.

item.title: VibeView — via free-for-dev
item.description: Browser-based iOS, Android, Apple TV and Android TV simulators with AI-powered test automation from a recorded flow or plain-language instructions. Free tier includes two concurrent sessions and 30 minutes of streaming per month. Bringing your own API key bypasses the included AI usage credit.

item.title: Unkey — via free-for-dev
item.description: Open-source API key management and rate-limiting platform. Free for up to 100,000 requests per month and 100 active API keys, with full access to key creation, revocation, and rate-limiting capabilities.

item.title: LiveCodes — via free-for-dev
item.description: An open-source client-side code playground that supports 90+ languages/frameworks. Projects can be saved, exported, shared, synced, deployed (to GitHub Pages) and embedded in web pages. Mobile-friendly. Can be self-hosted. Free for unlimited usage. No account required.

item.title: WebTerm Learn — via free-for-dev
item.description: Learn the Linux terminal, Git and Vim in a simulated terminal in the browser. All 129 lessons are free; the first lesson of each course needs no account.

item.title: Watchgoose — via free-for-dev
item.description: Cron job and heartbeat monitoring and status pages for scheduled tasks, backups and background jobs, MCP server available. Free tier: 10 checks, 200 ping log entries, email/chat/webhook alerts, no credit card. Open Source support program for qualifying OS projects.

item.title: SqlInt — via free-for-dev
item.description: In-browser SQL workspace with free tools including a JOIN visualizer, SQL formatter, CSV/JSON to SQL converters, and practice questions with no account or credit card required.

item.title: Makeform — via free-for-dev
item.description: Chat-based form builder. The free form builder with unlimited forms and submissions. 99% of the features are free, includes adding logos, conditional logic, file uploads, payments, integrations, and webhooks. Pro Plan ($19/month) enables remove the Makeform Branding, custom domains and team features. Business plan ($59/month) enables RBAC, email verification and single sign on (SSO).

item.title: Labelixa — via free-for-dev
item.description: Zebra ZPL label rendering and validation API and browser viewer. Free tier includes an anonymous rendering quota and barcode generation with no watermark, no card required.

item.title: Unitpost — via free-for-dev
item.description: AI-First Transactional & Marketing Email Service. Free tier: 5,000 emails/mo, 200 emails/day, 10,000 contacts, 5 domains. No credit card required. SDKs, MCP and REST API available.

item.title: Is It Disposable — via free-for-dev
item.description: Detect and block disposable email addresses. Free plan of 250 lookups a month and no card required.

item.title: EmailGuard — via free-for-dev
item.description: Block disposable emails, catch typos, and validate MX records via a simple API. 100 free requests/month.

item.title: Formboost.app — via free-for-dev
item.description: Developer-first form backend with simple HTTP endpoints, 500 free submissions/month, spam protection, email notifications, and built-in Slack, Discord & Telegram integrations. No backend required.

item.title: SMTPfast — via free-for-dev
item.description: SMTPfast is a simple email API for developers with a free tier that includes 3,000 emails/month, 1 domain, and 1,000 contacts, with no credit card required.

item.title: Renderwolf — via free-for-dev
item.description: UK-based screenshot, PDF, image, QR code and clip rendering API with reusable templates and signed URLs. 250 free renders a month with no payment details needed to get started.

item.title: DeadBro — via free-for-dev
item.description: Rails APM with request-based pricing: live traces, slow SQL, N+1 detection, and error tracking. Free forever for 50k requests/month, 7-day retention, 1 app, 1 uptime check, and email alerts. No credit card required.
